evidence: Web /checkin 与小程序 pkg-user/checkin-assistant/index 自述同一后端 /api/checkin/*；两端均为签到助手 + 个人号池，数据互通。证据：apps/web/app/(main)/checkin/page.tsx 头注；apps/miniapp-taro/src/pkg-user/checkin-assistant/index.tsx:17

Web /edu/attendance 与小程序 pkg-user/edu-my-attendance/index 均为学生本人考勤：列表 + 自签；同用 GET /edu-ai-management/attendance/me 与 POST /edu-ai-management/attendance/self-check-in，身份按登录态收敛。证据：apps/miniapp-taro/src/pkg-user/edu-my-attendance/index.tsx:7-9；apps/mobile-rn/src/screens/EduMyAttendanceScreen.tsx
